death.attack.miscelanea.potro: %1$s was torn apart on the rack
block.miscelanea.jaula_colgante.ayuda: Place it under a ceiling: an iron gibbet cage hangs from its chain
block.miscelanea.jaula_colgante.ayuda2: Right-click the cage while leading a captive: put them in · empty hand: door · jailer's key: lock it
block.miscelanea.jaula_colgante.ayuda3: Ring: click lowers the cage, Shift + click raises it · inside, A/D in time with the swing to break the chain
block.miscelanea.cepo.ayuda: Right-click while leading a captive (or with someone behind the board): head and hands through the holes, 60 s
block.miscelanea.cepo.ayuda2: Throw rotten tomatoes and eggs: points and combos · released by whoever locked them in or the jailer's key
item.miscelanea.llave_carcelero.ayuda: Locks or unlocks the hanging cage and opens the pillory's padlock
item.miscelanea.llave_carcelero.ayuda2: Right-click a prisoner with a ball: removes the ankle shackle
item.miscelanea.tomate_podrido.ayuda: Throw it: it bursts and leaves a pulp stain right where it hits (water washes it off)
item.miscelanea.tomate_podrido.ayuda2: 3 hits in 5 s on the same target: TOMATO RAIN! · on someone in the pillory, points (the face is worth more)
item.miscelanea.huevo_podrido.ayuda: Throw it: it breaks and leaves yolk, white and shell stuck where it hits
item.miscelanea.huevo_podrido.ayuda2: Worth one point more than a tomato on the pillory
item.miscelanea.bola_preso.ayuda: Right-click a captive: an ankle shackle with an iron ball and its chain
item.miscelanea.bola_preso.ayuda2: The prisoner drags it (very slow, no sprinting or jumping); Shift + click the ball: carry it, right-click to throw it
item.miscelanea.bola_preso.ayuda3: Removing it: whoever put it on (another ball or Shift + empty hand), the jailer's key or a hacksaw
item.miscelanea.sierra.ayuda: With a ball and chain, right-click: saw through the chain (move the mouse back and forth in rhythm)
item.miscelanea.sierra.ayuda2: Right-click another prisoner: cut theirs · the blade wears when you fail
msg.miscelanea.jaula.sin: No cage hangs here (click with a hanging cage to add one)
msg.miscelanea.jaula.al_suelo: Lowering the cage to the ground
msg.miscelanea.jaula.sin_llave: You unlock it (the door stays shut)
msg.miscelanea.jaula.dentro: You've been locked in a hanging cage
msg.miscelanea.jaula.atrapado: CLANG! The door slams shut behind you
msg.miscelanea.jaula.encerrado: Locked · swing (A/D in rhythm) to break the chain
msg.miscelanea.jaula.puerta_cerrada: The door is shut: right-click to open it
msg.miscelanea.jaula.balanceo: They've locked you in. Swing with A/D along with the sway: if the chain is weak, it will snap...
msg.miscelanea.jaula.libre: The cage bursts on the ground: you're free!
hud.miscelanea.jaula.llave: Locked in · A/D along with the swing
hud.miscelanea.jaula.cerrada: Door shut · right-click to open it
msg.miscelanea.cepo.atrapado: You're in the pillory: you can't do anything
msg.miscelanea.cepo.candado: It's padlocked: only whoever locked it or the jailer's key opens it
msg.miscelanea.cepo.nadie: Bring a captive (on your shoulder, on a chain or lassoed) or put someone behind the board
msg.miscelanea.cepo.encerrado: %s, in the pillory (60 s) · let the tomatoes fly!
msg.miscelanea.cepo.encerrado_tu: You've been put in the pillory. When you see something coming, move your head (A/D)
msg.miscelanea.cepo.libre: You get out of the pillory
msg.miscelanea.bola.no_cautivo: Only on a captive (shackles, lasso, pillory or cage)
msg.miscelanea.bola.puesta_tu: A ball and chain is locked to your ankle: no sprinting or jumping. Shift + click the ball to pick it up
msg.miscelanea.bola.quitada: The ball is taken off your ankle
msg.miscelanea.bola.ya: Already has a ball (only whoever put it on can remove it)
msg.miscelanea.sierra.mellada: The blade jams and gets nicked
qte.miscelanea.ayuda.serrar: Mouse back and forth: follow the marker that comes and goes
qte.miscelanea.ayuda.esquiva: Move your head the other way!
item.miscelanea.collar_explosivo.ayuda: Right-click a captive or a mob: lock it around their neck and get the linked detonator
item.miscelanea.collar_explosivo.ayuda2: If they get more than 24 blocks away from whoever holds the detonator (or the captor), it beeps faster and faster and blows after 10 s
item.miscelanea.collar_explosivo.ayuda3: Sneak + right-click in the air: put it on yourself to test (the signal stays fixed where you are)
item.miscelanea.detonador.ayuda: Hold right-click for 2 s: detonate the linked collar
item.miscelanea.detonador.ayuda2: Sneak + right-click: unlock it remotely (the collar comes back to you); whoever carries it is the collar's signal
item.miscelanea.alicates.ayuda: While wearing a bomb collar, right-click: try to defuse it by cutting the right wire
item.miscelanea.alicates.ayuda2: Right-click someone else wearing one: defuse theirs. Two wrong wires and it blows
item.miscelanea.granada_miedo.ayuda: Right-click: throw it; it releases a green gas cloud that causes 45 s of fear
item.miscelanea.granada_miedo.ayuda2: Players hallucinate worse and worse; mobs flee in terror. Breathing more gas raises the dose (up to III). Milk cures it
item.miscelanea.dardo_miedo.ayuda: Right-click: blow it from the blowgun (fast and nearly straight)
item.miscelanea.dardo_miedo.ayuda2: Whoever it hits: 45 s of fear; every extra dart (after 5 s) raises the dose (up to III)
death.attack.miscelanea.collar_explosivo: %1$s was blown up by %2$s's bomb collar
msg.miscelanea.collar.no_cautivo: They must be restrained to put the collar on
msg.miscelanea.collar.puesto: Collar locked on %s: they can't get more than %s blocks away from you (or whoever holds the detonator)
msg.miscelanea.collar.puesto_mismo: You put the collar on: don't go more than %2$s blocks from here
msg.miscelanea.collar.victima: A bomb collar has been locked around your neck. Don't go more than %s blocks away... or it will blow
msg.miscelanea.collar.alarma: SIGNAL LOST! Get back before it blows
msg.miscelanea.alicates.error: Wrong wire! The collar speeds up... one more and it blows
msg.miscelanea.detonador.sin_senal: No signal: that collar is gone
qte.miscelanea.cables.r4_1: If there is more than one red wire and the serial number ends in an odd digit: cut the last red wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r4_2: Otherwise, if the last wire is yellow and there are no red wires: cut the first wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r4_3: Otherwise, if there is exactly one blue wire: cut the first wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r4_4: Otherwise, if there is more than one yellow wire: cut the last wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r5_1: If the last wire is black and the serial number ends in an odd digit: cut the fourth wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r5_2: Otherwise, if there is exactly one red wire and more than one yellow wire: cut the first wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r5_3: Otherwise, if there are no black wires: cut the second wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r6_1: If there are no yellow wires and the serial number ends in an odd digit: cut the third wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r6_2: Otherwise, if there is exactly one yellow wire and more than one white wire: cut the fourth wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r6_3: Otherwise, if there are no red wires: cut the last wire.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r_piloto: If the CHARGE light is on, read the wires bottom to top: the "first" one is the bottom one.
qte.miscelanea.cables.r_orden: With the light off, the first wire is the top one (number 1).
block.miscelanea.pendulo.ayuda: Right-click with a captive: lay them face up and strap wrists and ankles under the blade
block.miscelanea.pendulo.ayuda2: Click the table: lever (start / stop) · mouse wheel: speed · hold click on the head end: raise it
block.miscelanea.pendulo.ayuda3: It swings and drops notch by notch (50 s at speed 1): if it reaches the bottom, it cuts. The victim can break the 4 straps
block.miscelanea.silla_inmersion.ayuda: Place it on the shore facing the water: the chair sinks into the block behind the post (2 deep)
block.miscelanea.silla_inmersion.ayuda2: Right-click with a captive: strap them to the chair · HOLD click on the post to dunk it (release: it rises)
block.miscelanea.silla_inmersion.ayuda3: Click the counterweight rest: lock it down / release it · underwater, the victim holds their breath
msg.miscelanea.aparato.dentro_4: You've been strapped under the pendulum...
msg.miscelanea.aparato.dentro_5: You've been strapped to the ducking stool...
msg.miscelanea.aparato.metido_4: %s is strapped under the pendulum. Click the table to start it
msg.miscelanea.aparato.metido_5: %s is strapped to the stool. Hold right-click on the post to dunk them
msg.miscelanea.pendulo.parado: Lever back: the pendulum slows to a stop
msg.miscelanea.pendulo.arriba: The blade is already all the way up
msg.miscelanea.pendulo.abajo: The blade has reached the bottom
msg.miscelanea.pendulo.libre_tu: You're free! You roll off the table
msg.miscelanea.inmersion.sin_agua: There's no water where the chair sinks: place it on the shore facing the water (the block behind the post)
msg.miscelanea.inmersion.poco_hondo: The water is shallow: better two blocks deep behind the post
msg.miscelanea.inmersion.suelta: Chair released: it rises on its own
hud.miscelanea.pendulo.captor: Click the table: lever · wheel: speed · hold click on the head end: raise
hud.miscelanea.inmersion.ayuda: %s: raise your pulse (keep it in the calm)
hud.miscelanea.inmersion.captor: Hold click on the post: dunk · click the rest: lock
